subject: İngilizce
source: MEB 2026-2027 çerçeve yıllık planı · Türkiye Yüzyılı Maarif Modeli

units.name: School Life
units.topics: Students of different countries, nationalities, and languages; capitals of their countries, and tourist attractions; activities in their capitals and countries; national days and celebrations

questions.q: "Where are you from?" "I'm from Japan. I'm ___."
questions.explain: Ülke adı Japan, milliyet ise Japanese'dir: I'm Japanese.

questions.q: What is the capital city of Canada?
questions.explain: Kanada'nın başkenti Ottawa'dır. Toronto en kalabalık şehridir.

questions.q: People in Mexico speak ___.
questions.explain: Meksika'nın resmî dili İspanyolcadır (Spanish). Milliyet ise Mexican'dır.

questions.q: She is from Italy. She is ___.
questions.explain: İtalya'dan gelen biri Italian'dır; konuştuğu dilin adı da Italian'dır.

questions.q: ___ your sister a student?
questions.explain: Tekil özne (your sister) ile "to be" fiilinin soru biçimi "Is" olur.

questions.q: We ___ from Ordu. It is a beautiful city in Türkiye.
questions.explain: "We" öznesiyle "are" kullanılır.

questions.q: Republic Day is celebrated on ___ in Türkiye.
questions.explain: Cumhuriyet Bayramı 29 Ekim'de kutlanır. 23 Nisan Ulusal Egemenlik ve Çocuk Bayramı, 19 Mayıs Gençlik ve Spor Bayramı, 30 Ağustos Zafer Bayramı'dır.

questions.q: The Eiffel Tower is a famous tourist attraction in ___.
questions.explain: Eyfel Kulesi Fransa'nın başkenti Paris'tedir.

questions.q: Big Ben is in ___.
questions.explain: Big Ben, Londra'daki parlamento binasının saat kulesindeki çanın adıdır.

questions.q: "Hi, I'm Lena. I'm German and I'm fifteen. I live in Berlin, the capital of Germany. I can speak German and a little English." Which sentence is TRUE?
choices: Lena lives in the capital city of her country.
questions.explain: Lena, Almanya'nın başkenti Berlin'de yaşıyor. Biraz İngilizce de konuşabiliyor.

questions.q: People in Scotland are Scottish. What is their main language?
questions.explain: İskoçlar Scottish'tir ama ana dilleri İngilizcedir (English).

questions.q: "___ is the capital of Australia?" "Canberra."
questions.explain: Bir şeyin adını sorarken "What" kullanılır: What is the capital of Australia? Avustralya'nın başkenti Canberra'dır.

questions.q: "Can you speak Chinese?" "No, I ___."
questions.explain: "Can" ile sorulan soruya kısa olumsuz cevap "No, I can't." olur.

questions.q: They are Australian. ___ country is Australia.
questions.explain: İyelik sıfatı "their" (onların) kullanılır: Their country.

questions.q: A famous place that many tourists visit is called a ___.
questions.explain: Turistlerin ziyaret ettiği ünlü yerlere "tourist attraction" denir; örneğin Ayasofya ya da Kapadokya.

questions.q: India - Indian - ___ (one of the main languages)
questions.explain: Hindistan'da konuşulan başlıca dillerden biri Hintçedir (Hindi); İngilizce de yaygındır.

questions.q: A: Nice to meet you. B: ___
questions.explain: "Nice to meet you" (Tanıştığıma memnun oldum) sözüne "Nice to meet you, too" diye karşılık verilir.

questions.q: His name is Kenji. He is from Tokyo. Tokyo is the capital of ___.
questions.explain: Tokyo, Japonya'nın başkentidir.

questions.q: Write a short introduction (3-4 sentences) for an exchange student from another country. Include the name, nationality, city and languages.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: Hello! My name is Carlos. I'm Mexican and I'm sixteen. I live in Mexico City, the capital of Mexico. I can speak Spanish and English.

questions.q: Write 3 sentences about a national day in Türkiye. When is it and what do people do?
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: Republic Day is on 29 October. People decorate their houses and streets with Turkish flags. Students take part in ceremonies at school and there are fireworks in the evening.

units.name: Classroom Life
units.topics: Classmates, friendships, daily and study routines, habits, and activities

questions.q: I usually ___ up at seven o'clock on weekdays.
questions.explain: Geniş zamanda (present simple) "I" öznesiyle fiil yalın kullanılır: I wake up.

questions.q: She is never late for school. She ___ arrives on time.
questions.explain: Hiç geç kalmıyorsa her zaman (always) zamanında gelir.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
choices: He plays often basketball after school.
Often he plays after school basketball.
He often plays basketball after school.
He plays basketball often after school always.
He often play basketball after school.
questions.explain: Sıklık zarfları (often, always…) genellikle ana fiilin önüne gelir ve üçüncü tekil şahısta fiil -s alır.

questions.q: "How often do you check your messages?" "___"
questions.explain: "How often" sıklık sorar; cevap "twice a day" (günde iki kez) gibi bir sıklık ifadesidir.

questions.q: My brother ___ his homework in the evening.
questions.explain: Üçüncü tekil şahısta "do" fiili "does" olur.

questions.q: ___ you take the bus to school?
questions.explain: Geniş zamanda "you" öznesiyle soru "Do" ile kurulur.

questions.q: She doesn't ___ breakfast on weekdays.
questions.explain: "doesn't" yardımcı fiilinden sonra fiil yalın hâlde kullanılır: doesn't have.

questions.q: "To do household chores" means ___.
questions.explain: Household chores; bulaşık, çamaşır, toz alma gibi ev işleridir.

questions.q: I go to the post office and the market for my mother. I ___ for her.
questions.explain: "Run errands" birinin işlerini görmek, ufak tefek dış işleri halletmek anlamına gelir.

questions.q: In class, I listen to the teacher and write down the important points. I ___.
questions.explain: "Take notes" not almak demektir.

questions.q: "What time does the first lesson start?" "It ___ at 8.30."
questions.explain: Özne "it" olduğu için fiil -s alır: It starts.

questions.q: We have a break ___ 10 o'clock.
questions.explain: Saatlerden önce "at" kullanılır: at 10 o'clock.

questions.q: ___ Monday mornings, we have two English lessons.
questions.explain: Günlerden önce "on" kullanılır: on Monday mornings.

questions.q: "Selin gets up at 6.45. She has breakfast at 7.15 and leaves home at 7.40. Her school starts at 8.10." When does Selin leave home?
questions.explain: Metinde "leaves home at 7.40" yazıyor.

questions.q: A classmate is someone who ___.
choices: is in the same class as you
questions.explain: Classmate, aynı sınıftaki arkadaştır.

questions.q: "I hardly ever watch TV." means ___.
choices: I watch TV twice a day.
questions.explain: "Hardly ever" neredeyse hiç anlamındadır.

questions.q: Every morning Elif ___ her face and gets dressed.
questions.explain: Üçüncü tekil şahısta -sh ile biten fiiller -es alır: washes.

questions.q: Ali doesn't like maths, ___ he loves science.
questions.explain: Zıt düşünceleri bağlamak için "but" (ama) kullanılır.

questions.q: Write 4 sentences about your weekday routine. Use adverbs of frequency (always, usually, sometimes, never).
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: I always get up at 7 o'clock. I usually have breakfast with my family. I sometimes walk to school with my friends. I never go to bed after 11 p.m.

questions.q: Write 3 sentences about your study habits.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: I usually study in my room after dinner. I take notes in class and read them again at home. Before exams, I study with my classmates and we ask each other questions.

units.name: Personal Life: Physical Appearance & Personality
units.topics: Physical appearance in terms of physical features and personality in terms of personal traits and characters

questions.q: "What does your brother look like?" "___"
choices: He is tall and has curly hair.
questions.explain: "What does … look like?" dış görünüşü sorar.

questions.q: "What is your sister like?" "___"
questions.explain: "What is … like?" kişiliği (karakteri) sorar.

questions.q: What is the opposite of "shy"?
questions.explain: Shy (utangaç) kelimesinin zıttı outgoing (dışa dönük, girişken) kelimesidir.

questions.q: What is the opposite of "polite"?
questions.explain: Polite (kibar) kelimesinin zıttı rude (kaba) kelimesidir.

questions.q: She always forgets her keys and her homework. She is ___.
questions.explain: Sürekli bir şeyleri unutan kişi forgetful (unutkan) olarak tanımlanır.

questions.q: He shares everything with his friends. He is ___.
questions.explain: Elindekini paylaşan kişi generous (cömert) olarak tanımlanır.

questions.q: My grandfather is 78 years old. He is ___.
questions.explain: Yaşlı insanları kibarca anlatmak için "elderly" kullanılır.

questions.q: Her hair isn't straight. It's ___.
questions.explain: Straight (düz) saçın zıttı curly (kıvırcık) ya da wavy (dalgalı) saçtır.

questions.q: Everyone says that Mert looks ___ his father. They have the same eyes and smile.
questions.explain: "Look like" birine benzemek demektir.

questions.q: She ___ long blonde hair and blue eyes.
questions.explain: Üçüncü tekil şahısta "have" fiili "has" olur.

questions.q: Tom is 1.80 m and his brother is 1.70 m. Tom is ___ than his brother.
questions.explain: Kısa sıfatların karşılaştırma biçimi -er ile yapılır: taller than.

questions.q: Which is the correct order?
questions.explain: Sıfat sıralamasında boyut (long), renkten (brown) önce gelir.

questions.q: He goes to the gym every day. He is strong and ___.
questions.explain: Well-built, iri yapılı ve güçlü vücutlu anlamına gelir.

questions.q: "Brave" means ___.
questions.explain: Brave cesur demektir.

questions.q: "Deniz is medium-height and slim. He has short black hair and he wears glasses. He is very clever and a bit shy." Which is NOT true about Deniz?
questions.explain: Metinde Deniz'in orta boylu (medium-height) olduğu yazıyor; çok uzun değil.

questions.q: My friend never gets angry. She is always ___.
questions.explain: Hiç sinirlenmeyen kişi calm (sakin) olarak tanımlanır.

questions.q: He always tells the truth. He is ___.
questions.explain: Her zaman doğruyu söyleyen kişi honest (dürüst) olarak tanımlanır.

questions.q: "Let's go to the cinema on Saturday!" "That ___ great!"
questions.explain: Bir öneriye "That sounds great!" (Harika fikir!) diye cevap verilir.

questions.q: Write three sentences about your best friend. Describe his or her appearance and personality.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: My best friend is Elif. She is medium-height and she has long curly hair. She is friendly, hard-working and very funny.

questions.q: Write 3 sentences comparing two people in your family. Use comparatives.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: My father is taller than my mother. My sister is more outgoing than me. My grandfather is older but he is calmer than everyone in our family.

units.name: Family Life
units.topics: Family members’ jobs, work routines, work activities and workplaces

questions.q: A ___ works in a pharmacy and gives people medicine.
questions.explain: Eczanede çalışan kişi pharmacist (eczacı) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: A/An ___ designs buildings.
questions.explain: Binaları tasarlayan kişi architect (mimar) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: A lawyer usually works at a ___.
questions.explain: Avukat (lawyer) bir hukuk bürosunda (law firm) çalışır.

questions.q: A ___ writes news stories for newspapers and websites.
questions.explain: Haber yazan kişi journalist (gazeteci) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: A ___ writes code and develops apps.
questions.explain: Kod yazıp uygulama geliştiren kişi computer programmer (bilgisayar programcısı) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: A security guard ___ the building and the people in it.
questions.explain: Güvenlik görevlisi binayı ve insanları korur (protects).

questions.q: "What does your mother do?" "___"
questions.explain: "What does … do?" mesleği sorar.

questions.q: My father works ___. He works from home on his computer and doesn't go to the office.
questions.explain: Remotely, uzaktan (evden) çalışmak anlamındadır.

questions.q: A content creator ___ videos and posts for social media.
questions.explain: İçerik üreticisi sosyal medya için video ve paylaşım hazırlar.

questions.q: Look! The photographer ___ photos of the students now.
questions.explain: "Look!" ve "now" şu an olan bir eylemi gösterir; şimdiki zaman (is taking) kullanılır.

questions.q: She ___ at a bank. She is a bank clerk.
questions.explain: Üçüncü tekil şahısta fiil -s alır: She works.

questions.q: A ___ helps people with their feelings and problems.
questions.explain: İnsanların duygusal sorunlarına yardım eden kişi psychologist (psikolog) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: A digital marketer works to increase ___ for a company.
questions.explain: Dijital pazarlamacı, şirketin markasının bilinirliğini (brand awareness) artırmaya çalışır.

questions.q: Where does a scientist usually work?
questions.explain: Bilim insanı genellikle laboratuvarda çalışır.

questions.q: My uncle works at a shopping centre. He ___ customers and helps them find what they need.
questions.explain: Mağazada çalışan kişi müşterilere hizmet eder (serves customers).

questions.q: "My mother is a nurse. She works at a hospital and she sometimes works at night. My father is an accountant. He works at an accounting firm from 9 to 5." Which sentence is TRUE?
choices: Her mother works at an accounting firm.
Her mother sometimes works at night.
Her parents work at the same place.
questions.explain: Metinde annenin hastanede çalıştığı ve bazen gece çalıştığı yazıyor.

questions.q: "Does your sister work at a hospital?" "No, she ___. She works at a school."
questions.explain: "Does" ile sorulan soruya kısa olumsuz cevap "No, she doesn't." olur.

questions.q: My aunt is a pharmacist, ___ she works at a pharmacy.
questions.explain: Sonuç bildirmek için "so" (bu yüzden) kullanılır.

questions.q: Write 3-4 sentences about the job of a family member. Include the workplace and daily work routine.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: My father is an engineer. He works at a hazelnut factory in Ordu. He starts work at 8 a.m. and checks the machines every day. He sometimes works at weekends.

questions.q: What job would you like to have in the future? Write 3 sentences and give a reason.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: I would like to be a computer programmer. I love computers and I enjoy solving problems. I want to make useful apps for students.

units.name: Life in the House & Neighbourhood
units.topics: Types of houses, rooms, furniture and activities in the house

questions.q: A house that is joined to another house on one side is a ___.
questions.explain: Semi-detached house, bir duvarı komşu evle ortak olan (ikiz) evdir.

questions.q: A tall building with many flats is a ___.
questions.explain: İçinde birçok daire bulunan yüksek bina block of flats (apartman) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: We keep our clothes in the ___.
questions.explain: Kıyafetler gardıropta (wardrobe) saklanır.

questions.q: We usually cook meals in the ___.
questions.explain: Yemek mutfakta (kitchen) pişirilir.

questions.q: There ___ a sofa and two armchairs in the living room.
questions.explain: "There is" ile "There are" arasında seçimi ilk isim belirler. "a sofa" tekil olduğu için "There is" kullanılır.

questions.q: There ___ three bedrooms upstairs.
questions.explain: Çoğul isimle (three bedrooms) "There are" kullanılır.

questions.q: "___ there a garage in your house?" "Yes, there is."
questions.explain: Tekil isim için soru "Is there…?" ile kurulur.

questions.q: The lamp is ___ the table. (It is standing on top of it.)
questions.explain: Bir şeyin üstünde duran nesne için "on" kullanılır.

questions.q: The cat is hiding ___ the bed.
questions.explain: Altında anlamında "under" kullanılır.

questions.q: The bathroom is ___ the kitchen and the bedroom.
questions.explain: İki şeyin arasında anlamında "between … and …" kullanılır.

questions.q: Shh! My father ___ in the living room.
questions.explain: Şu anda olan bir eylem için şimdiki zaman kullanılır: is sleeping.

questions.q: "What are you doing?" "I ___ the dishes."
questions.explain: "What are you doing?" sorusu şu an ne yapıldığını sorar; cevap şimdiki zamanla verilir.

questions.q: A small, old house in the countryside is a ___.
questions.explain: Kırsaldaki küçük ve şirin ev cottage olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: We wash and dry our clothes in the ___.
questions.explain: Çamaşır makinesinin bulunduğu oda utility room (AmE: laundry room) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: In American English, a "flat" is called an ___.
questions.explain: İngiliz İngilizcesindeki flat, Amerikan İngilizcesinde apartment'tır.

questions.q: "Is there a park near your house?" "Yes, there ___."
questions.explain: "Is there…?" sorusuna kısa olumlu cevap "Yes, there is." olur.

questions.q: "Our flat is on the third floor. It has two bedrooms, a living room, a small kitchen and a balcony. There isn't a garden, but there is a big park opposite our building." Which is TRUE?
choices: There is a park opposite the building.
The flat is on the first floor.
questions.explain: Metinde binanın karşısında büyük bir park olduğu yazıyor.

questions.q: The fridge is in the kitchen, ___ to the cooker.
questions.explain: Yanında anlamında "next to" kullanılır.

questions.q: Describe your house or flat in 3-4 sentences. Use "there is / there are" and prepositions of place.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: I live in a flat in a block of flats. There are three bedrooms and a big living room. There is a sofa in front of the window and a bookcase next to it. My bedroom is between the bathroom and the kitchen.

questions.q: It's Sunday afternoon. Write 3 sentences about what your family members are doing now.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: My mother is reading a book in the living room. My father is cooking dinner in the kitchen. My little brother is playing video games in his bedroom.

units.name: Life in the City & Country
units.topics: Local and international food culture and food festivals in the city

questions.q: Lahmacun is a traditional ___ dish.
questions.explain: Lahmacun (Turkish pizza) geleneksel bir Türk yemeğidir.

questions.q: Lemons taste ___.
questions.explain: Limonun tadı ekşidir (sour).

questions.q: Chilli peppers are ___.
questions.explain: Acı biber acıdır (spicy / hot).

questions.q: How ___ eggs do we need for the cake?
questions.explain: Sayılabilen çoğul isimlerle (eggs) "How many" kullanılır.

questions.q: How ___ milk is there in the fridge?
questions.explain: Sayılamayan isimlerle (milk) "How much" kullanılır.

questions.q: There isn't ___ bread left. Can you buy some?
questions.explain: Olumsuz cümlelerde "any" kullanılır.

questions.q: Would you like ___ tea?
questions.explain: Bir şey ikram ederken soru cümlesinde bile "some" kullanılır: Would you like some tea?

questions.q: I'd like ___ apple, please.
questions.explain: Sesli harfle başlayan tekil isimden önce "an" kullanılır: an apple.

questions.q: Sushi is a traditional dish from ___.
questions.explain: Suşi bir Japon yemeğidir.

questions.q: Tacos are a famous dish from ___.
questions.explain: Tako bir Meksika yemeğidir.

questions.q: Couscous is a popular dish in ___.
questions.explain: Kuskus, Kuzey Afrika'da, özellikle Fas'ta yaygın bir yemektir.

questions.q: Which ingredient do you need to make an omelette?
questions.explain: Omlet yumurtayla (eggs) yapılır.

questions.q: In American English, "aubergine" is called ___.
questions.explain: Patlıcanın İngiliz İngilizcesindeki adı aubergine, Amerikan İngilizcesindeki adı eggplant'tir.

questions.q: This soup is too ___. I need some water!
questions.explain: Çok tuzlu yemek susatır; "salty" tuzlu demektir.

questions.q: A big event where people taste food from different places is a ___.
questions.explain: Farklı yemeklerin tadıldığı büyük etkinliğe food festival denir.

questions.q: "Cuisine" means ___.
questions.explain: Cuisine, bir ülkenin ya da bölgenin yemek kültürüdür; örneğin Turkish cuisine (Türk mutfağı).

questions.q: Waiter: "Are you ready to order?" Customer: "___"
choices: Yes, I'd like the fish soup, please.
questions.explain: Garsonun sipariş sorusuna "I'd like…" ile cevap verilir.

questions.q: "Dessert" is ___.
choices: the sweet food at the end of a meal
the first course of a meal
questions.explain: Dessert, yemeğin sonunda yenen tatlıdır; baklava buna örnektir.

questions.q: Describe a traditional dish from your city in 3-4 sentences. Include the ingredients and the taste.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: Pancar çorbası is a traditional soup from the Black Sea region. People make it with black cabbage, corn flour, beans and onions. It is hot and a little salty. We usually eat it with corn bread in winter.

questions.q: Write a short dialogue (4 lines) between a waiter and a customer at a restaurant.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: Waiter: Good evening. Are you ready to order? Customer: Yes, I'd like a kebab and a salad, please. Waiter: Would you like anything to drink? Customer: Some ayran, please.

units.name: Life in the World & Nature
units.topics: Nature, endangered animals, their natural living conditions and habitats, and protection of them

questions.q: Polar bears live in the ___.
questions.explain: Kutup ayıları Kuzey Kutbu bölgesinde (Arctic) yaşar.

questions.q: Pandas mostly eat ___.
questions.explain: Pandalar neredeyse yalnızca bambuyla beslenir.

questions.q: "Endangered" animals are animals that ___.
questions.explain: Endangered (nesli tükenmekte olan) hayvanların sayısı çok azalmıştır ve yok olma tehlikesiyle karşı karşıyadır.

questions.q: Overfishing threatens sharks. "Threaten" means ___.
questions.explain: Threaten, tehdit etmek ya da tehlikeye atmak anlamındadır.

questions.q: We ___ protect endangered animals and their habitats.
questions.explain: Tavsiye ve gereklilik bildirmek için "should" kullanılır.

questions.q: You ___ hunt endangered animals. It is illegal.
questions.explain: Yasak bildirmek için "mustn't" kullanılır.

questions.q: The cheetah is ___ land animal in the world.
questions.explain: Bir grubun en'ini anlatmak için üstünlük derecesi kullanılır: the fastest.

questions.q: A whale is ___ than a dolphin.
questions.explain: İki şey karşılaştırılırken "-er than" kullanılır. Big kelimesinde son harf ikilenir: bigger.

questions.q: Sea turtles are at risk because they sometimes eat ___ bags in the sea.
questions.explain: Deniz kaplumbağaları plastik poşetleri denizanası sanıp yutabilir; deniz kirliliği onları tehdit eder.

questions.q: "Habitat loss" means ___.
choices: the loss of the natural home of animals
questions.explain: Habitat loss, hayvanların doğal yaşam alanlarını kaybetmesidir; ormanların kesilmesi buna yol açar.

questions.q: Thick, warm forests with a lot of rain are called ___.
questions.explain: Bol yağışlı, sık ormanlar rainforests (yağmur ormanları) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: Penguins can't ___, but they can swim very well.
questions.explain: Penguenler kuştur ama uçamaz; çok iyi yüzerler.

questions.q: A ___ is a person who works without pay to help others or nature.
questions.explain: Volunteer, gönüllü demektir.

questions.q: Which is a good way to help endangered animals?
choices: Buying products made from their skin
questions.explain: Yaban hayatı koruma kuruluşlarına bağış yapmak koruma çalışmalarını destekler.

questions.q: Asian elephants ___ a lot of water every day.
questions.explain: Çoğul özneyle (elephants) geniş zamanda fiil yalın kullanılır.

questions.q: "The Mediterranean monk seal is one of the rarest animals in the world. Fewer than 1000 of them live today. They live in sea caves along the coasts of Türkiye and Greece." Which is TRUE?
choices: There are millions of monk seals.
Monk seals live in sea caves.
questions.explain: Metinde Akdeniz foklarının deniz mağaralarında yaşadığı ve sayılarının 1000'den az olduğu yazıyor.

questions.q: Caretta caretta is a kind of ___ that lays eggs on Turkish beaches like Dalyan.
questions.explain: Caretta caretta bir deniz kaplumbağası türüdür ve Türkiye kıyılarına yumurtlar.

questions.q: Illegal hunting is a big problem. We call it ___.
questions.explain: Yasa dışı avcılık poaching olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: Write 3 things people should do to protect endangered animals. Use "should" or "must".
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: We should protect their habitats and stop cutting down forests. People mustn't hunt endangered animals or buy products made from them. We should reduce plastic waste because it pollutes the seas.

questions.q: Choose an endangered animal and write 3-4 sentences about it: its habitat, food and the danger it faces.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: The tiger is an endangered animal. It lives in forests and grasslands in Asia. It eats meat, for example deer. Tigers are in danger because of habitat loss and illegal hunting.

units.name: Life in the Universe & Future
units.topics: Films, film genres, futuristic films with futuristic ideas, and technology

questions.q: A film about robots, aliens and space travel is a ___ film.
questions.explain: Robotlar, uzaylılar ve uzay yolculuğu bilim kurgu (science fiction) filmlerinin konusudur.

questions.q: A funny film that makes people laugh is a ___.
questions.explain: Güldüren filmler komedi (comedy) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: A film that shows real facts about nature or history is a ___.
questions.explain: Gerçek bilgileri anlatan filmler belgesel (documentary) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: A film about the real life of a famous person is a ___ film.
questions.explain: Gerçek bir kişinin hayatını anlatan filmler biyografik (biographical) filmlerdir.

questions.q: A film that makes people scared is a ___ film.
questions.explain: Korkutan filmler korku (horror) filmleridir.

questions.q: I think people ___ live on Mars in the future.
questions.explain: Gelecekle ilgili tahminlerde "will" kullanılır.

questions.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
questions.explain: Şu anki bir kanıta dayanan tahminlerde "be going to" kullanılır.

questions.q: I've already bought the tickets. I ___ watch the new superhero film tonight.
questions.explain: Önceden planlanmış işler için "be going to" kullanılır.

questions.q: "Do you think robots will do our homework in the future?" "No, they ___."
questions.explain: "Will" ile sorulan soruya kısa olumsuz cevap "won't" (will not) ile verilir.

questions.q: "I'm into sci-fi films." means ___.
choices: I really like science fiction films.
questions.explain: "Be into something" bir şeye çok ilgi duymak, sevmek anlamındadır.

questions.q: "Virtual reality" means ___.
questions.explain: Virtual reality (VR), bilgisayarla oluşturulan ve gerçekmiş gibi hissettiren ortamdır.

questions.q: In some films, characters go back to the past. This is called ___.
questions.explain: Geçmişe ya da geleceğe gitmeye time travel (zamanda yolculuk) denir.

questions.q: The person who manages the making of a film and tells the actors what to do is the ___.
questions.explain: Filmi yöneten kişi director (yönetmen) olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: An ___ is a woman who acts in films.
questions.explain: Kadın oyuncu actress, erkek oyuncu actor olarak adlandırılır.

questions.q: Scientists ___ new planets in space every year.
questions.explain: Var olan ama bilinmeyen bir şeyi bulmak "discover" (keşfetmek) ile anlatılır. Var olmayan yeni bir şey yapmak ise "invent" (icat etmek) ile anlatılır.

questions.q: The Wright brothers ___ the first successful aeroplane.
questions.explain: Daha önce var olmayan bir makineyi ilk kez yapmak icat etmektir (invent).

questions.q: "Galaxy Kids is a fantastic space adventure. The special effects are amazing, but the film is a bit too long. I give it 4 stars out of 5." What does the writer think about the film?
choices: It is great, but too long.
questions.explain: Yazar filmi beğenmiş ama biraz uzun bulmuş; 5 üzerinden 4 yıldız vermiş.

questions.q: In superhero films, the main characters usually ___ the world from dangerous enemies.
questions.explain: Süper kahramanlar dünyayı kurtarır (save).

questions.q: Write 3-4 predictions about life in 2050. Use "will" and "won't".
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: In 2050, people will travel in flying cars. Robots will help us with housework. Students won't carry heavy school bags because all books will be digital. Some people will live on the Moon.

questions.q: Write a short review (3-4 sentences) of a film you like. Include the genre, what it is about and your opinion.
questions.explain: Örnek cevap: My favourite film is an animated science fiction film about a little robot. It is about a robot that cleans the Earth and falls in love. The story is touching and the music is beautiful. I give it 5 stars.
